summary: Decision is ERROR and cannot be approved: the required DeepSeek review result is missing (AI_REQUIRED_UNAVAILABLE), so the hard guard rule blocks release. Beyond that blocker, the report shows a first-time add of Deployment/Service/ServiceMonitor demo in namespace demo with a changed pod template, so there is no prior version to fall back on. Capacity math is not trustworthy: 35 scheduled Pods have no CPU/memory requests and are counted as zero, which may overstate free capacity, and a KubeCPUOvercommit warning alert is firing. Traffic is zero (request_rate 0, no error ratio or p95), so absence of errors or latency cannot be read as health. Only one worker is Ready, and the control-plane node must not be counted as schedulable capacity. Recommend holding the release until the AI review is supplied, Pod requests are set, and the overcommit alert is explained.
